title: The game I'm creating with Claude code and codex
author: MMPhotoshop
selftext:
I'm Italian, so you might see some writing in Italian in the video.

The game starts in deep space and we find ourselves in a very future world. This scene features a battle between the protagonist and some monsters defending a server that powers an AI. I don't give many spoilers. One of the most beautiful things is the golden cube you see behind, that is the city and it develops on different levels. It's a gigantic city. The proportions of everything are huge because it is a 1:1 scale map of planet Earth.

It's still a pre-alpha for me, so it will be a long time before I publish the draft. In the scene you see, the shots change by themselves to create a continuous cinematic effect. There will be no scripted story in this game, you will be the one to discover all the mysteries and what happened to the world. It will also be a mix of "Minecraft", so you will have to create your own things. There will also be economic markets and you will have to invest correctly in the stock market, manage finances, fight, explore, pick up girls and boys. You can buy the spaceship, the house, anything. The hard part was the movement without gravity, because I recreated it by hand and I still have to perfect it. The weapons are totally different, you see that the player has little spheres and it is not clear. 

It will take me a long time since the AI agents run out of time and tokens very quickly with this job.

comments.author: forgingtheflow
comments.body: I don’t quite know what’s happening in the video, the creature looks organic like a giant bug but it appears to shoot missiles? Are the players balls teleporting into the missile?

replies.author: MMPhotoshop
replies.body: Yes, exactly, I'll hopefully improve it later. These monsters are robots, but organic. In the game, among other things, it is discovered that the AI has built robots and that it has refined the robots to the point of making them organic. This is because nature is what is most perfect in a certain sense of view. I'm glad you're interested in it, thank you very much.

replies.author: MMPhotoshop
replies.body: Yes, the spheres you see are self-defense spheres. In this gameplay, the player has full armor and automatically defends himself from missiles, otherwise he'd be wiped out. I thought of this missile system together with Codex during a brainstorming session. The idea is that just one of these robots could defeat the entire Chinese army without any problems.
